message.content:
- Design quality is high, with a sleek, modern layout typical of professional car brand sites.  
- Light/clean theme is evident, using ample white space and minimalist elements.  
- No visible watermarks, broken images, or text issues; all visuals and text appear intact.  
- Branding (JETOUR logo, model names) is clear and consistent throughout.  
- Color contrast (e.g., red accents, dark text on light backgrounds) enhances readability.
